scenarios.name: Emphasis morphing
scenarios.proves: One Emphasis dial re-grades every equipped card's term
checks: Slide Emphasis from Hint to Dominant on the Nature panel
The equipped cards' grade names change on their faces
The merged prompt swaps in the louder terms

scenarios.name: Comma merge order
scenarios.proves: Terms join the line in S, N, O, I, C order, deduplicated
checks: Open the output dock and read the assembled line
The subject leads; heavy impact, metallic, sharp attack, very loud?, dramatic trailer follow in that order
No term appears twice even if two cards contribute the same words

scenarios.name: Ambience setting
scenarios.proves: Ambience places the setting first and retains all equipped terms
checks: Read the assembled prompt with four cards equipped
The setting follows the subject and all four terms appear
Turn ambience off and the setting moves to the end

scenarios.name: One sound per line
scenarios.proves: The rack holds separate one-sound prompts; lines never merge

draft.subject: birds chirping in the deep forest

checks: Open the Context panel's layer rack
Two rack lines sit apart from the live prompt, each with its own copy button
Nothing concatenates them - Firefly gets one sound per generation

scenarios.name: Describe it directly
scenarios.proves: A leading "the sound of" is stripped before composing

draft.subject: the sound of a lion roaring

checks: Read the assembled prompt in the output dock
It begins "a lion roaring" - the leading phrase is gone
Adobe's first don't cannot reach the prompt from this deck
